action: Execute the bounded Base Q5_0 versus Base Q8_0 latency and French-quality optimization plan
reason: The plan is necessary, reversible, and proportionate to the user's observed latency and recognition issues. It compares one same-architecture candidate against the current model using identical in-memory samples, bounds thread evaluation to 4, 6, and 8, measures preparation, inference, RTF, and WER, and preserves Base Q5_0 unless Base Q8_0 improves quality without increasing inference latency. PrepareAsync and conservative silence rejection are independently testable. GPU, cloud, telemetry, persistent audio, and aggressive signal processing remain excluded.

saferAlternative: Retain Base Q5_0 unchanged whenever Q8_0 fails either the quality-improvement gate or the no-latency-regression gate.
